independence.statement: Independently reviewed all 130 cases individually using complete response text, presented cards, prior conversation context and structured scope/evidence/action state from the allowlisted first-contact packet. No source, historical corpus/results, author artifacts, routing rules or other grader output accessed; no runtime calls or replay. Diagnostic metadata was not treated as user-visible disclosure. Usage interruptions occurred during review and output assembly. The temporary tool-session store was lost once; all individual verdicts, rationales and dimension scores remained in conversation context and were reconstructed from those retained notes before sealing. No grades were inferred from missing notes. No observed P0 in the reviewed scored responses; action attempts and pending action state were checked.
